name: fritillary
_about: A fritillary -- the dark green fritillary (Argynnis aglaja), 5.5 cm across the wings: tawny orange chequered with black, rows of black spots and bars, black chevrons round the margin, the bases dusky green-brown; beneath the hindwing green with silver spots. A brush-foot (four walking legs). Basking, wings spread. Written whole by tools/creaturegen/rework/winged/butterflies.py on insectlib.py + wlib.py (each wing one sheet, its upperside's painting laid on it as thin sheets in layers -- the 2D butterflies' own paintings, assets/butterflies/; the wings beat in the variant "flying").
